employers.title: Employers
employers.description: Company names to look up, e.g. ["stripe","nvidia"]. Partial names work. Leave empty to search by job title or city across all employers.

jobTitle.title: Job title
jobTitle.description: Filter by job title, e.g. "data scientist". Combines with employers and city.

city.title: City
city.description: Filter by work location city, e.g. "seattle".

years.title: Filing years
years.description: Years to pull, e.g. [2024, 2025]. Leave empty to use the most recent year that has filings. Note the site has no "all years" option, so each year is fetched separately.

includeSummary.title: Include summary row
includeSummary.description: Add one row with the median, 25th and 75th percentile, minimum and maximum base salary for everything matched.

maxRows.title: Max salary rows
maxRows.description: Salary rows to return after sorting. The summary row does not count towards this.
